integrity: Complete analytic proof in the package; exact-integer enumeration only supplements finite identities. Self-review, not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The law applies to a fixed integer exponent r>=2, exact dyadic cutoffs, and internal restricted-sum counting, not prime-plus-sum representation density. The effective Kolmogorov exponent is not proved optimal. Relevant Chen and Ding-Li full texts could contain an implicit equivalent conclusion and remained inaccessible.
title: Sharp dyadic fluctuation laws for mixed Romanoff-type power sums
